text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hummmmm... Not too bad, I suppose――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"—No, that's not it!
The place I must aim for is even further beyond!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of dropping anchor here!
You feel the same, don't you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Today's run had its own brilliance, too
Let's aim for even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I definitely cut through that crashing wave.
That sensation was real.
choice_data_list: Let's take the results for what they are.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Finishing in the money is a result we earned together!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
With this radiance to fuel us,
let us forge ahead toward the glory that awaits beyond!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, keep piling it up!
Victories, fortune, glory――"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"And what stands beyond that...
Is our castle!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Full speed ahead!
Let's head toward the next route, shall we!
